question: The committee headed by Radhakrishna recommended ______.

options.text: The initiation of Regulatory Policy for Microfinance Institutions
the initiation of the National Rural Livelihood Mission

solution:
The correct answer is __**the initiation of the National Rural Livelihood Mission.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
